DongleRoute embedded local ADB transport

LibADB Android 3.1.1, copyright 2021 Muntashir Al-Islam.
The Apache-2.0 alternative is selected. Some components additionally carry
BSD-3-Clause attribution, copyright 2013 Cameron Gutman, and MIT notices.
Upstream and modifications: localadb/UPSTREAM-PATCHES.md in the app source.
https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/libadb-android/tree/3.1.1

SPAKE2 Android 2.2.1, copyright 2021 Muntashir Al-Islam, LGPL-3.0.
https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/spake2-java/tree/2.2.1
Commit 7615ddd680b990e14513ebb66eac4cb0dbf82464.
SPAKE2 contains native C/JNI and CC0-derived ED25519 implementations as
described in its source. The native Android implementation is linked here.
This app's complete source/build instructions are available at:
https://github.com/nyxbydesign/dongle-route
Build a modified SPAKE2 AAR from its corresponding source and replace the pinned
dependency in localadb/build.gradle, then rebuild the app using the documented
Gradle command. Debugging modifications to the linked library is permitted.
The LGPL and its incorporated GPL text accompany this application.

Conscrypt Android 2.9.0, The Conscrypt Authors, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/google/conscrypt/tree/2.9.0
Its native TLS implementation incorporates BoringSSL; retain the corresponding
source and license notices when rebuilding Conscrypt.

BouncyCastle bcprov-jdk15to18 1.87, The Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc.,
MIT-style license. Its matching source-release license accompanies this app.
https://www.bouncycastle.org/about/license/

AndroidX annotations 1.9.1, The Android Open Source Project, Apache-2.0.
https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/annotation

Library licenses and source availability do not establish physical-phone
compatibility. See the project README for actual verification and limitations.
